title: Best Sightseeing Pair
description: For indices `i < j`, the sightseeing score is `values[i] + values[j] + i - j`. Given a positive integer array `values`, return the maximum score over all pairs. Input: `values`. Output: the best pair score.
hints: Maintain the prefix or window information needed to count candidate ranges.
Check repeated values, extreme bounds, and cases with no valid segment.
